requirement.evidence: It is unlawful for any person to do any of the following acts, wholly or in part, based on a person’s source of income  (except as may be necessary to comply with any program requirements related to source of income ):
requirement.note: Refusal to rent/renew, termination, false unavailability, advertising, income standards counting entire income and aggregate with co-tenants/cosigners are all in §98.0803; the source of income definition covers rental, security deposit, and homeless assistance. 'Section 8' is not named but falls under federal rental assistance.

key_value.evidence: If the court determines that a violation occurred during a tenancy, then the court shall award to the individual whose rights are violated three (3) times the amount of one month’s rent that was being charged for the rental-unit at the time of violation.
key_value.note: Treble one month's rent; pre-tenancy uses advertised rent. 'Per violation' is a slight gloss.

effective_date.evidence: (“Prohibition of Discrimination Based on a Tenant’s Source of Income”  added 9-18-2018 by O–20986 N.S.; effective 10-18-2018.)
effective_date.note: Effective 2018-10-18. Note that enforcement by private action applies to violations on or after August 1, 2019.
